reviews.title: Great value, modern looking, the RGB fans are an awesome bonus!
reviews.comment: This case is a great value. I was in a pinch, and needed something next day, so honestly that was one of my primary criteria. I was hoping to get something white, with lots of glass so I could show off the RGB lights of all of the internal components, so having a case preloaded with all of the cooling fans with RGB built in was an unexpected and awesome bonus. The case is roomy without being bulky, modern in that it doesn't have 5-1/4" drive bays, has a front (actually top) multimedia panel including USB 2.0, 3.0 as well as usb-c, power and reset buttons, and even an RGB on/off button (if you can make that work with your setup, I had a few extra steps I had to go through it make it work, but worth it!). Again, lots of room without being too big, no fitment issues with anything. Cons.. I guess the pci card slot blanks could be better quality - these are break away style, so once you snap one out, you'll have that hole in the back of the case if you remove, or move, the card. Simple enough, buy a couple of blanks for a few bucks, but would have been a nice touch if they included that from the start. Edges are a bit sharp on the case internals - I cut my hand pretty good while installing the power supply cables, not knowing the sheetmetal inside where the power supply lives was never rounded or machined, it's just the sharp edge that happens after stamping the metal. The external edges are all machines and nice, so once set up a total non issue, but just be aware while assembling, use caution. The RGB fans comes prewired and jumped together. The final hookup cable however was very short, and on the opposite side of the motherboard from where my connections had to be made. I was able to do disconnect all of the fans and daisy chain them together in opposite arrangement, and have a tight stretched cable diagonally across the top of the mother board to get it to plug in, but it was ugly. Ultimately, I wound up buying a few extension cables for the RGB and actual fan power cables, and then everything dressed in nice. Again, would just be nice if they included those same jumper cables so it was in the package ready to use. I'd happily pay an extra $10 or whatever to include the cables and PCI blanks and have them in the kit, rather than having to find out 90% of the way through the build they are needed and not in the box The power supply mounts in a welded in cage that's part of the case. This makes for a nice, clean looking install when its all done. However, it also makes it a bit of a challenge to work on getting all of the cables routed through and if you need to add an extra cable later, be prepared to potentially have to unplug everything , remove the power supply and cables, add the new cable and then reinstall everything, as there really is no direct access to the back of the power supply because of that cage. Minor issue, and does look nice when it's done, but would have been awesome if there was a removable panel that could make servicing or changes easier. Overall, the 'cons' I list are very critical and minor issues, and I would still purchase it again in a heartbeat, and fully recommend to anyone looking for a decent small desktop tower form factor case in white, with lots of glass and very modern look and feel, at an incredible price point. I would not hesitate to pay $100 for this, especially if those issues I mentioned were addressed, but I paid significantly less, even having purchased the blanks and cable extenders. Great value, very happy with the final result.
reviews.author: J. R.

reviews.author: Caesar

reviews.title: Stylish, Spacious, and Easy to Build In – Great Value Case!
reviews.comment: I recently used the darkFlash ATX Mid-Tower Case for a new build, and it exceeded my expectations. The tempered glass side panel gives it a premium look, and the RGB fans included are vibrant and surprisingly quiet. The airflow is excellent right out of the box, which keeps my system cool even under load. The interior is very builder-friendly—plenty of room for cable management, space for full-sized GPUs, and mounts for multiple SSDs and HDDs. I also appreciated the PSU shroud, which keeps the bottom area clean and organized. Overall, this case looks great, performs well, and offers features usually found in more expensive cases. Highly recommend for gamers or anyone looking to build a clean, modern PC on a budget.
reviews.author: JRussett

reviews.title: Great at this price point
